Subject: POC Timeline & Milestones - Acme Industries

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can lock the POC/trial plan in place. Please review and confirm (or propose adjustments):

1) Success criteria (what will make this a win for Acme)
   - End-user latency <= 400ms p50 on representative queries
   - >= 90% accuracy on the evaluation test set (per the spreadsheet attached)
   - Integration: ability to score requests via API with SSO-enabled access
   - Demonstrate cost estimate within the target budget for 100k tokens/month

2) Evaluation plan
   - Acme to provide sample dataset and evaluation prompt set (see attached acme-success-criteria.xlsx)
   - Redwood will run two baseline runs (opt-quant and full float) and provide quantitative metrics + qualitative failure cases

3) Ownership
   - Redwood AE: Marissa Cole (me) — commercial coordination, timeline, CRM updates
   - Redwood SE: Rishi Malhotra — integration, auth, SSO, infra guidance
   - Redwood CSM: Monica Patel — onboarding check-ins, success tracking
   - Acme: Tom Hansen (product owner) and Priya Sharma (data lead)

4) Proposed timeline / milestones
   - Kickoff call: week of Apr 5 (proposed: Tue Apr 6) — agenda: scope, data exchange, access, success verification plan
   - Week 1 (Apr 6–12): data handoff, sandbox access, initial integration
   - Week 2 (Apr 13–19): model runs, metric collection, iterate on prompts
   - Week 3 (Apr 20–26): optimization pass, cost tuning, finalize metrics
   - Final readout: week of May 3 (demo + results, go/no-go)

5) Next steps (today)
   - Tom/Priya: confirm success criteria and kickoff date (Apr 6 works for us)
   - Acme: share sample data + evaluation prompt set to the Drive folder linked below
   - Rishi: to scope SSO/auth questions and provide checklist

Attachments: ACME-POC-plan-v1.docx, acme-success-criteria.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_poc_folder
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ACME-4592

If that all looks right, I’ll schedule the kickoff and weekly 30-minute check-ins (Tuesdays 10am PT by default).

Thanks —

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Overall the plan looks good. A few notes/questions: 

- Kickoff: Tue Apr 6 should work for the core team, can you send a calendar invite for Apr 6 at 10am PT?
- Data access: we'll be providing a sanitized sample dataset. Do you prefer S3 share or will Drive be fine for initial runs?
- SSO / Auth: Acme requires SAML-based SSO for any demo or staging environment that has customer data. Will we need an on-prem or private deployment for that, or can Redwood support SAML against our IdP for the trial?
- Success criteria: the latency target looks reasonable; we want to add an availability checkpoint (99.5% during peak hour) — is that feasible within the trial?

Priya and I will coordinate to get the prompt set and sample data uploaded this week.

Thanks Tom — confirmed on our side for Apr 6 at 10am PT. I’ll send the calendar invite shortly.

A few clarifications:
- Data handoff: Drive is fine for the initial sample dataset. For anything with sensitive customer data we recommend S3 + temporary credentials or a secure upload to your VPC for Private deployment. We can start on Drive for evaluation metrics.
- SSO/SAML: Redwood supports SAML SSO for Dedicated/Private deployments. For the hosted trial we can set up a short-lived SSO proxy or use token-based access while we scope a Dedicated test environment if needed. Rishi will scope the exact options and surface any lead time.
- Availability target: we can instrument availability checks during peak-hour runs; we’ll include a basic uptime test in the metric collection and report 99.5% if the environment meets it. If we need SLA-like guarantees that will require Dedicated capacity discussion (we can cover as an option post-trial).

Tom/Priya — please upload the sample prompts + dataset to the Drive folder and share access with rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com and monica_patel@redwoodinference.com. Once uploaded I’ll confirm the kickoff agenda and send calendar invites (kickoff + weekly 30m check-ins).

Thanks,
Marissa
